author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

Add `PhysicsTools/ONNXRuntimeAlpaka`, modelled on `PhysicsTools/PyTorchAlpaka`, to run ONNX Runtime inference directly on PortableCollection SoA data:
  - TensorCollection and TensorHandle are adapted copies of the PyTorchAlpaka ones, using ONNX Runtime element types and without the const-copy Policy;
  - AlpakaSession binds the ONNX Runtime session to an alpaka queue: on the CUDA backend the queue's stream is passed as user_compute_stream and the inference runs asynchronously in it; other queues are synchronised with alpaka events;
  - tensors spanning several SoA columns are packed into (and unpacked from) contiguous buffers by alpaka kernels, or used in place with the FeatureMajor layout.

Add ONNX Runtime alpaka tests: `PhysicsTools/ONNXRuntimeAlpakaTest` conteins examples and unit tests for `PhysicsTools/ONNXRuntimeAlpaka`: SimpleNet, MultiHeadNet, MaskedNet and TinyResNet run with ONNX Runtime directly on alpaka SoA collections.
They cover mini-batches, the copy-free feature-major layout and per-event-queue synchronisation, and an InspectionSink checks each model's known output properties on the serial, CUDA and ROCm backends.

**Notes**
  - the `.onnx` models should go to an external
  - I have neither written (Claude Opus 5.5 did) nor read this code (yet), consider it a proof-of-principle
  - this PR builds on top of, and currently includes, #51968 and #52006. It also requires cms-sw/cmsdist#10873. Most signatures should no longer be required once those PRs are merged.

#### PR validation:

New unit tests pass.
title: Add ONNX Runtime inference on alpaka SoA data
